WITH circuit_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    r.circuitId,
    c.country,
    AVG(r.round) as circuit_avg_round
  FROM races r
  INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country
),
country_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    AVG(r.round) as country_avg_round
  FROM races r
  INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT 
  ca.circuitId,
  ca.country,
  ca.circuit_avg_round,
  ca.circuit_avg_round - cnt.country_avg_round as difference
FROM circuit_avgs ca
LEFT JOIN country_avgs cnt ON ca.country = cnt.country
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10
